summary: Fail closed on non-allowlisted host Git configuration and preserve read-only clone/worktree metadata across candidate output staging.

compatibility.detail: Host Git permits only inert repository shape/format, origin URL/fetch, branch remote/merge, user identity and integrator bookkeeping keys; unknown local keys fail before repository operations. Common and per-worktree config are safe-opened and parsed without includes.

manual.detail: Orchestration clones must use only documented allowlisted local Git keys. Candidate Git metadata remains read-only and output staging must not alias it.

recovery.detail: Rejected configuration does not activate a candidate; correct the deployment-owned configuration before retrying.
